events.title: Gulf crisis: Guterres calls for de-escalation, warns against return to full-on war
events.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres voiced deep concern on Wednesday over the continuing military escalation in the Middle East amid ongoing strikes by the United States and Iran over control of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Security Council LIVE: International Criminal Court briefs on Darfur
events.summary: On Wednesday, the Security Council heard an update on the International Criminal Court's work in Sudan's Darfur region, referred to the Court back in 2005. Focus has recently turned to atrocities in the ongoing war between the Sudanese Arm...

events.title: Colombia: Pockets of insecurity challenge ‘vibrant democracy’, Security Council told
events.summary: As Colombia awaits the inauguration of its newly elected president, pockets of insecurity remain a challenge for a nation that has overcome decades of conflict, the head of the UN verification team there told the Security Council on Wednes...

events.title: Looted gold and gum arabic are bankrolling Sudan's war, UN warns
events.summary: Alongside gold, the little-known Sudanese commodity gum arabic – used in soft drinks, food, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals – continues to fuel the war.

events.summary: The UN World Food Programme (WFP) is calling for greater humanitarian access to Gaza, warning that restrictions on aid deliveries, ongoing violence and funding shortages are severely limiting its ability to reach people in need.

events.title: UN chief urges Iran and US to ‘urgently resume negotiations’ as Gulf strikes escalate

events.title: New cholera outbreak alert for Sudan’s war-weary communities
events.summary: In war-torn Sudan, a deadly new cholera outbreak has already claimed more than 100 lives, heightening serious concerns for vulnerable communities including in besieged El-Obeid, where daily drone attacks have continued to hamper aid access.

events.title: Remembering the Srebrenica genocide: ‘Fear is all that kept me moving’
events.summary: The United Nations paused on Thursday to remember the more than 8,000 Bosnian Muslim men and boys killed in the town of Srebrenica in July 1995, and the women and survivors left to rebuild their lives in the aftermath.

events.title: Use of explosive weapons ‘must stop’ in eastern DR Congo: Türk
events.summary: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk urged the armed forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group to cease hostilities as he deplored recent civilian deaths on Thursday.

events.title: US-Iran war: Renewed attacks in Strait of Hormuz prompt another global energy alert
events.summary: Renewed attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz unsettled energy markets on Wednesday and prompted calls from the UN maritime agency, IMO, for “maximum restraint and de-escalation”.

events.title: Peace hinges on people-centred policing, global summit hears
events.summary: Policing is the cornerstone of peace, said top UN officials ahead of the fifth UN Chiefs of Police Summit, which began on Tuesday.

events.title: UN maritime agency seeks release of 44 detained seafarers as food runs low
events.summary: The UN’s International Maritime Organization (IMO) appealed on Monday for the urgent release of 44 seafarers held captive in Somali waters by pirates and armed robbers.

events.title: Ukraine: Latest Russian assault leaves at least 14 dead in Kyiv
events.summary: Russian strikes on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv killed at least 14 civilians and injured more than 80 others overnight on Monday, according to local authorities.

events.title: Invisible peacebuilders: How ‘diplomacy works’ to prevent conflict
events.summary: Described as “sometimes modest, sometimes historic,” UN special political missions have quietly been preventing the escalation of conflicts during the organization’s 80-year history, becoming a key instrument for maintaining peace.

events.title: Civilian dangers multiply as drones transform Ukraine’s battlefield
events.summary: As drones reshape the battlefield in Ukraine, they are also creating new and increasingly complex dangers for civilians, threatening recovery efforts, agriculture and global food security long after the fighting ends.

events.title: Sudan’s people subject to ‘relentless’ drone strikes in El Obeid
events.summary: The war in Sudan threatens to spiral further as the strategically-important town of El Obeid continues to face “relentless” drone attacks by advancing paramilitary militias, the UN’s human rights chief, Volker Türk, said on Friday.

events.title: Security Council LIVE: Emergency meeting on Iranian attack in Bahrain

events.title: Ukraine: Rescuers work to save trapped residents after wave of Russian attacks
events.summary: Aid agencies in Ukraine on Thursday rushed to respond to a massive uptick in deadly strikes by Russia, including one of the largest attacks on Kyiv to date.

events.title: World News in Brief: Risk of atrocities in Sudan, UN programme prevents climate displacement, more civilians killed in Ukraine
events.summary: Drone attacks by advancing rebel fighters who are besieging El Obeid, Sudan, continue to result in civilian casualties, putting around half a million civilians at grave risk of large-scale atrocities.
